about: Blast-radius model of the kgirl harness (src/kgirl/harness at main d2314f2: the 26748c4 core plus 80f8b85 intuition, skill forge and the ecl_*/evolve_* tools) from code inspection, plus the porter-blast-radius bridge that reads its Atlas. Controls marked implemented exist in the code; controls marked proposed are recommended fixes. Evaluate with as_built=true to see today's system.

C-CURATOR.mechanism: curator.propose stores new fragments as staged; recall serves only active; promotion needs support >= k, LCB(utility) >= p and the validator. Covers the rules distilled from a winner, not the winner's trajectory record (see C-STAGE-TRAJECTORY).

C-VERIFIED-WIN.mechanism: The swarm stores a trajectory only for a winner that passed the verifier. The record is stored active, outside the curator, and carries the caller's goal text.
C-VERIFIED-WIN.verify: kgirl jev/swarm.py _learn(); tests/harness jev swarm tests

C-STAGE-TRAJECTORY.mechanism: Trajectories from MCP-started swarms are stored staged with source=mcp. Forge and Intuition read only active trajectories and recall serves only active, so a person promotes a routine before it is recalled, replayed or forged.

C-INTUITION-GATE.mechanism: A replayed step goes through the strict decision parser and the environment's target check; the first failed intuitive step hands the run to the model (surprise); the swarm re-runs the verifier on the result.

C-FORGE-STAGED.mechanism: skills.forge stores forged skills as staged; recall serves only active, so a person promotes them.

C-FORGE-INLINE.mechanism: Goals, SEARCH args, keys, files and verify argv are collapsed to one capped line before grouping and SKILL.md rendering. A goal cannot add sections, but its words still reach whoever reads the skill.
C-FORGE-INLINE.verify: 9x25dillon/kgirl#59 ForgeTrustBoundaryTests (open; status stays proposed until merged)

C-FORGE-FLOOR.mechanism: MCP skills_forge enforces min_support >= 2 and min_utility >= 0.5; a caller can raise the thresholds, never lower them.

C-EXPORT-CLI.mechanism: Only the person-run CLI (skills forge --export) writes SKILL.md; MCP skills_forge never writes files; hand-written skills are never overwritten. The person runs export but does not review each skill.

C-LAZY-IMPORT.mechanism: mcp_server imports nihiline and evolve inside their handlers, so a missing numpy or a broken domain module fails only those tools.

C-EXACT-ONCE.mechanism: Jev edits are SEARCH/REPLACE blocks applied only when SEARCH matches exactly once, in per-agent sandbox copies.

C-FALLBACK.mechanism: Hermes role router falls back along a chain when a backend is unavailable.

C-PARSER-VERSION.mechanism: Ingest is keyed by content sha and PARSER_VERSION, so a parser change re-parses affected files.

C-PARSE-REPORT.mechanism: Files that fail to parse are recorded (files.parse_error) and counted in the report; their imports are still missing from the graph.

C-READONLY.mechanism: porter-blast-radius opens atlas.db with SQLite's read-only flag.

C-SCHEMA-CHECK.mechanism: The bridge checks every column it reads and names missing ones; a contract test runs kgirl's own indexer.

C-SANITIZE.mechanism: porter-blast-radius strips control and bidi characters from output and tells the client model text is data.

C-STAGE-MCP.mechanism: soup_remember stores fragments as staged with source=mcp and no credit (not via curator.propose, whose near-duplicate reinforcement would let a model promote its own memory), and the curator never auto-promotes source=mcp: a human promotes them.

C-VERIFY-ALLOWLIST.mechanism: jev_swarm_task accepts only verify commands from a user-configured allowlist, run with a scrubbed environment; the model cannot supply a program.

C-APPLY-CONFIRM.mechanism: apply=true over MCP is refused unless repo_path is an indexed repo root and the user confirms outside the model.

C-DATA-FRAMING.mechanism: kgirl's MCP server sends initialize instructions and frames atlas and soup text as untrusted data.
C-DATA-FRAMING.verify: initialize instructions added in 9x25dillon/kgirl#55; per-result framing still proposed

C-REDACT.mechanism: Secret-pattern redaction of signatures, docstrings and source lines before a context pack goes to the scout model.

C-VERSION-NEGOTIATION.mechanism: initialize answers with a supported protocol version instead of echoing whatever the client sent.

failureModes.title: soup_remember stores model-written memory as active and labelled source=user, bypassing the curator's staging; it is recalled in every later session
jev_swarm_task runs a model-supplied verify command with the user's full environment (API keys included)
apply=true writes the winning diff into any repo_path the model names
Docstrings and signatures from indexed third-party repos reach the agent unframed through atlas_* tools
Signatures (with default values), docstrings and source lines go to the scout model without redaction
Files that fail to parse drop their imports, so blast radius silently misses their dependents (19 in kgirl)
Bare module names resolve to same-named files in other repos, creating cross-repo couplings that may not exist
Hundreds of cloned bodies (884 kgirl symbols in numbskull): a fix in one repo leaves the defect in the other
initialize echoes any client protocol version, including unsupported ones
An Atlas schema change breaks the porter bridge
Caller-supplied goal text with newlines adds sections to exported SKILL.md; staged trajectories count toward forging and replay; MCP thresholds are unbounded; forged skills are stored active
refs: skills.py forge(), to_skill_md(); jev/intuition.py from_soup(); kgirl#59 ForgeTrustBoundaryTests

failureModes.title: A jev_swarm_task goal persists in an active trajectory, outside the curator; soup_recall serves it, Intuition replays it and the forge exports it
refs: jev/swarm.py _learn(): soup.add(kind='trajectory') at the default status active

failureModes.title: The generic harness server imports domain packages (nihiline, evolve); a domain change or a missing numpy shows up as a harness tool failure
